title: A key shipment is delayed
description: A supplier of sensor chips announces a customs delay on a shipment the production line depends on; a revised shipping notice later shortens the delay. Operations has little stock, Finance holds the late-delivery penalty clause, Sales only hears rumours.

company.name: Halden Instruments Ltd
company.description: a British maker of industrial sensors

people.name: Dana Hughes
people.persona: Direct and practical, short sentences, signs with first name only.

people.name: Tom Reyes
people.persona: Careful and formal, always precise about figures.

people.name: Priya Nair
people.persona: Chatty and informal, passes on things she hears.

facts.text: 2% of the order value per week

pieces.brief: Short supply contract between Halden Instruments and Kestrel Components for K7 sensor chips: a price clause (the fixed unit price) and a late-delivery penalty clause (a percentage of the order value for each week of delay). Two clauses, contract style, no other figures.
pieces.example:
Clause 1 - Price

The fixed unit price of the K7 sensor chip is €18.50 per unit.

Clause 2 - Late delivery

For each week of late delivery the Supplier owes a penalty of 2% of the order value per week.

header.title: Supply contract for K7 sensor chips

pieces.brief: Purchase order PO-4471 to Kestrel Components: the quantity ordered and the expected delivery date. A few lines, in the style of a purchase order.
pieces.example:
Quantity ordered: 1,200 units of K7 sensor chip.

Expected delivery: 14/12/2026.

pieces.brief: Warehouse export as a Markdown table, one row per item. Rows: K7 sensor chip (240 units, 6 days of cover) and M2 housing (900 units, 30 days of cover). No comments.
pieces.example:
| Item | On hand (units) | Days of cover |
|---|---|---|
| K7 sensor chip | 240 | 6 |
| M2 housing | 900 | 30 |

pieces.brief: Short section of the production plan: the daily consumption of K7 sensor chips on the assembly line. One or two sentences.
pieces.example: The assembly line uses 40 units a day of the K7 sensor chip.

pieces.brief: Shipping notice from Kestrel Components: the container with the K7 chips left the factory and is expected on the date given. Two lines.
pieces.example:
The container with order PO-4471 has left the factory.

Expected arrival: 14/12/2026.

pieces.brief: Priya Nair (sales) writes to Dana and Tom: she heard from a contact at the forwarder that the container might be stuck somewhere, but it is not confirmed. Informal, short, no figures.
pieces.example:
Hi both,

Heard from a guy at the forwarder that our container might be stuck somewhere on the way. It's not confirmed, so take it with a pinch of salt.

Priya

pieces.brief: Marcus Lee (Kestrel Components) writes to Dana Hughes: apologises, the shipment for order PO-4471 is held at customs and will arrive 22 days late, new expected arrival 05/01/2027. Polite, brief, with greeting and signature.
pieces.example:
Dear Dana,

I am sorry to tell you that the shipment for order PO-4471 is being held at customs. We now expect it to arrive 22 days late, on 05/01/2027.

Apologies for the inconvenience.

Kind regards,
Marcus Lee
Kestrel Components

pieces.brief: Short trade-press article: a backlog at the port's customs is slowing the release of containers for importers. Two sentences, no figures.
pieces.example: A backlog at the port's customs is slowing the release of containers for importers. Shippers warn that delays may continue for several weeks.

pieces.brief: Revised shipping notice from Kestrel Components: the container has been released by customs earlier than feared; the delay is now 15 days and the new expected arrival is 29/12/2026. Two or three lines.
pieces.example:
The container for order PO-4471 has been released by customs.

The delay is now 15 days. New expected arrival: 29/12/2026.
